text:
ops-lead: FYI scheduling a short rolling reboot to mitigate intermittent GPU IO spikes seen in apac-west1 + eu-central. Window: Tue 23:308:30 UTC (3h total). We'll do rack-by-rack cohorts, keep <=10% GPU capacity offline. Canary first.

ruth: Which pools & any Dedicated impact?

ops-lead: In-scope: apac-pool-alpha, apac-pool-beta, eu-pool-gamma. Dedicated pools remain pinned; we'll route burst to fallback pools in us-west where possible.

kai: Canary plan + KV warmup?

ops-lead: Canary = 1 rack in apac-pool-alpha at 23:30 for ~25m. Steps: cordon -> graceful drain -> BMC reboot -> smoke tests -> kv-seed -> uncordon. We'll pre-seed top-300 prefixes.

sam: Expected cost/latency hit?

ops-lead: Anticipate p50 latency +4%-6% during backfill; token-cost bump ~5% due to spill to less optimized variants. Recommend throttling interruptible tenants by 25% and bumping autoscale min by +1 per pool.

matt: Alerts will blow up. Which to mute?

ops-lead: Mute transient: `egress-jitter-apac` (40m) and `kv-drop` (15m) for the canary rack only. Do NOT mute `gpu-temp` or `node-down`.

infra-bot: Preflight: network baseline OK, no blocking NIC firmware, staging validation passed.

ops-lead: Owners/timeline:
- 23:00 UTC: final preflight (ops-lead + oncall)
- 23:30 UTC: canary cordon/drain (kai + oncall)
- 23:55 UTC: canary smoke tests (ruth)
- 00:151:45 UTC: staggered cohorts (sam + infra)
- 01:452:00 UTC: final verification + unmute alerts (ops-lead)

oncall: I'll be present for the canary with runbook open.

deploy-bot: Maintenance job created: maintenance/1775004321-gpu-io-spike-rollback-prep (eta 23:30 UTC).

kai: Abort criteria?

ops-lead: Abort if >1% sustained packet loss over 5m OR smoke tests fail OR cross-region egress >10% sustained for 10m. Fallback variant (v-stable-lowmem) is ready.

matt: I'll add cohort status panel to dashboards and a quick link to the runbook.

sam: I'll shift autoscaler and enable KV prefix caching during cohorts.

ruth: :thumbsup: available for smoke tests.

oncall: Standing by.

ops-lead: Thanks all 9preflight at 23:00 UTC. Will post updates here.
